mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PLAN_ID AS "planId", PLAN_NAME AS "planName", SHORT_DESC AS "shortDesc", PERIOD_TYPE AS "periodType", BASE_PRICE AS "price", THUMBNAIL_URL AS "imageUrl" FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PLAN WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER NULLS LAST, PLAN_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 4

SELECT PLAN_ID AS "planId", PLAN_NAME AS "planName", SHORT_DESC AS "shortDesc", PERIOD_TYPE AS "periodType", BASE_PRICE AS "price", THUMBNAIL_URL AS "imageUrl" FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PLAN WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER NULLS LAST, PLAN_ID DESC

SELECT PLAN_ID AS "planId", PLAN_NAME AS "planName", SHORT_DESC AS "shortDesc", DESCRIPTION AS "description", PERIOD_TYPE AS "periodType", BASE_PRICE AS "price", THUMBNAIL_URL AS "imageUrl" FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PLAN WHERE PLAN_ID = #{planId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SUBSCRIPTION_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SUBSCRIPTION ( SUBSCRIPTION_ID, PLAN_ID, USER_ID, STATUS, START_DATE, NEXT_BILLING_DATE, LAST_ORDER_NO, CDATETIME, UDATETIME ) VALUES ( #{subscriptionId}, #{planId}, #{userId}, NVL(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'), SYSDATE, ( SELECT CASE PERIOD_TYPE WHEN 'WEEKLY' THEN SYSDATE + 7 WHEN 'BIWEEKLY' THEN SYSDATE + 14 WHEN 'MONTHLY' THEN ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 1) ELSE NULL END FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PLAN WHERE PLAN_ID = #{planId} ), #{orderNo}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT PLAN_ID AS "planId", PLAN_NAME AS "planName", PERIOD_TYPE AS "periodType", BASE_PRICE AS "price", THUMBNAIL_URL AS "imageUrl", IS_ACTIVE AS "isActive" FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PLAN WHERE PLAN_ID = #{planId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SUBSCRIPTION_ORDER_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SUBSCRIPTION_ORDER ( SUB_ORDER_ID, SUBSCRIPTION_ID, ORDER_NO, AMOUNT, STATUS, BILLING_AT, CDATETIME, UDATETIME ) VALUES ( #{subOrderId}, #{subscriptionId}, #{orderNo}, #{amount}, NVL(#{status}, 'PAID'), SYSDATE, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE SUBSCRIPTION SET LAST_ORDER_NO = #{lastOrderNo}, NEXT_BILLING_DATE = CASE #{periodType} WHEN 'WEEKLY' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 7 WHEN 'BIWEEKLY' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 14 WHEN 'MONTHLY' THEN ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), 1) ELSE NULL END, UDATETIME = SYSDATE WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_ID = #{subscriptionId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.SUBSCRIPTION_ID AS "subscriptionId", s.PLAN_ID AS "planId", p.PLAN_NAME AS "planName", p.PERIOD_TYPE AS "periodType", p.BASE_PRICE AS "planPrice", p.THUMBNAIL_URL AS "imageUrl", s.STATUS AS "status", TO_CHAR(s.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startDate", TO_CHAR(s.NEXT_BILLING_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "nextBillingDate", s.LAST_ORDER_NO AS "lastOrderNo" FROM SUBSCRIPTION s JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_PLAN p ON p.PLAN_ID = s.PLAN_ID WHERE s.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY s.SUBSCRIPTION_ID DESC
